why: The repository inspection found no usable author code; the only code link is an anonymous.4open.science artifact that was not retrieved and is typically ephemeral. The method (equal-frequency binning, proximity assignment, one-hot encoding, cascading kernel-mean-embedding fallback) is described in the paper and can be reimplemented with scikit-learn on the public UCI datasets, so we rebuild from the paper and the claim contract.
missing_artifacts: exact preprocessing and missing-value handling details
blockers_seen: anonymous.4open.science link is ephemeral and not verified
paper omits low-level implementation details needed for an exact match

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: ~5-10 minutes for C1 (Hepatitis): pip install, download UCI data, run 5 bin settings × 10 K-means runs, then a clean re-run.

compute.basis: Reimplementation of the proximity kernel on 155×19 Hepatitis with 5 bin settings × 10 K-means runs (seconds per run); command time is dominated by environment setup and package installation.
